_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator and franchisor of 3,545 properties (618,104 rooms)'; 'Our industries are highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts, and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national, and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; 'Business conditions for our lodging business improved in 2010'; and, after the year end, 'we expect to spin off our timeshare operations and development business as a new independent company through a special tax-free dividend to our shareholders in late 2011' (its own FY2010 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator and franchisor of 3,545 properties (618,104 rooms)'; 'Our industries are highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts, and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national, and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; 'Business conditions for our lodging business improved in 2010'; and, after the year end, 'we expect to spin off our timeshare operations and development business as a new independent company through a special tax-free dividend to our shareholders in late 2011' (its own FY2010 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.93x; +43% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.07; conservative 2yr +15%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -37.6%/yr (worst year FY01-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.9%/yr (Q1 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.9%/yr (FY01-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +31.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2011-03-04) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.93x (71.1% downside to Bear $11 / +36.8% upside to Bull $52) | Adj composite 2.72 vs market 2.65: gap +0.07 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +43% above the EPP floor $27 (19x FY11E $1.40) | Conservative 2-yr case: +14.6% total (+7.3%/yr) | At 27.1x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $50 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; North American RevPAR +6.5% in Q4 2010, forward fee revenue +9.38-13.28% (Q1 2011 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
